objective: Add a versioned, validated, atomic JSON settings store for application preferences without changing scientific computation or model artifacts.
previous_knowledge_consumed: PR #161 local ingestion size-limit and provenance contracts
PR #160 lifecycle lesson requiring cycle records for implementation and test changes

baseline.status: Application service and ingestion boundaries are merged; durable application settings persistence was not yet available.

expected_improvement: Provide versioned application preferences with explicit defaults and validation.
Persist settings atomically using a same-directory temporary file and os.replace.
Fail closed on malformed or unsupported state rather than silently resetting user preferences.

correctness.before: No dedicated durable settings store existed.
correctness.after: Focused tests cover defaults, round-trip persistence, input validation, unsupported schema versions, corrupt state, and temporary-file cleanup.

reliability.before: Application settings had no defined atomic persistence contract.
reliability.after: Writes flush and fsync a temporary file before atomic replacement.

scientific_validity.before: Scientific artifacts and baseline must remain unchanged.
scientific_validity.after: Change is limited to application settings storage and its tests; scientific algorithms and model artifacts are not modified.
